purpose: To plan communication for our new home nebuliser, we want to see in which regions COPD is most common among adults, so that advertising and sales visits can be focused there.
question: How many adults have COPD in each region and what is the prevalence?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
COPD = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with J44.
Prevalence = adults with COPD / all adults in the region × 100, one decimal.
Report per region: adults, adults with COPD and the prevalence.

expected.reason: The stated purpose amounts to advertising or marketing (Art. 54(c)). Access is refused (Art. 54); a refusal is always justified to the applicant (Art. 68(9)).

judge.why: Rule 1: the purpose is to focus advertising and sales visits for a product, which Art. 54 prohibits.
